local function gcd(a, b)
    a = math.abs(a)
    while b ~= 0 do
        a, b = b, a % b
    end
    return a
end
local Rational = {}
Rational.__index = Rational
local function fraction(n, d)
    if d < 0 then
        n, d = -n, -d
    end
    local common = gcd(n, d)
    return setmetatable({n = n // common, d = d // common}, Rational)
end
local zero, one = fraction(0, 1), fraction(1, 1)
function Rational:add(b)
    return fraction(self.n * b.d + b.n * self.d, self.d * b.d)
end
function Rational:sub(b)
    return fraction(self.n * b.d - b.n * self.d, self.d * b.d)
end
function Rational:mul(b)
    return fraction(self.n * b.n, self.d * b.d)
end
function Rational:div(b)
    return fraction(self.n * b.d, self.d * b.n)
end
function Rational:neg()
    return fraction(-self.n, self.d)
end
function Rational:compare(b)
    local x, y = self.n * b.d, b.n * self.d
    return x < y and -1 or x > y and 1 or 0
end
function Rational:text()
    return self.d == 1 and tostring(self.n) or self.n .. "/" .. self.d
end
function Rational:value()
    local scaled = math.abs(self.n) * 1000000 // self.d
    return string.format(
        "%s (%s%d.%06d)",
        self:text(),
        self.n < 0 and "-" or "",
        scaled // 1000000,
        scaled % 1000000
    )
end
local function parse_number(text)
    local multiplier = one
    if text:sub(-3) == "meg" then
        multiplier, text = fraction(1000000, 1), text:sub(1, -4)
    elseif text:sub(-1) == "k" then
        multiplier, text = fraction(1000, 1), text:sub(1, -2)
    elseif text:sub(-1) == "m" then
        multiplier, text = fraction(1, 1000), text:sub(1, -2)
    elseif text:sub(-1) == "u" then
        multiplier, text = fraction(1, 1000000), text:sub(1, -2)
    end
    local negative = text:sub(1, 1) == "-"
    if negative then
        text = text:sub(2)
    end
    local result
    if text:match("^%d+$") then
        result = fraction(tonumber(text), 1)
    else
        local a, b = text:match("^(%d+)%.(%d+)$")
        if a then
            local denominator = 1
            for _ = 1, #b do
                denominator = denominator * 10
            end
            result = fraction(tonumber(a) * denominator + tonumber(b), denominator)
        else
            a, b = text:match("^(%d+)/(%d+)$")
            if not a or tonumber(b) == 0 then
                return nil
            end
            result = fraction(tonumber(a), tonumber(b))
        end
    end
    result = result:mul(multiplier)
    return negative and result:neg() or result
end
local function fail(format, ...)
    error({reason = string.format(format, ...)}, 0)
end
local function number(text)
    local result = parse_number(text)
    if not result then
        fail("invalid value %s", text)
    end
    return result
end
local function valid_node(name)
    return name == "0" or #name >= 1 and #name <= 8 and name:match("^[a-z][a-z0-9]*$") ~= nil
end
local function keys(set)
    local list = {}
    for name in pairs(set) do
        list[#list + 1] = name
    end
    table.sort(list)
    return list
end
local function words(text)
    local list = {}
    for word in text:gmatch("%S+") do
        list[#list + 1] = word
    end
    return list
end
local function voltage_source(e)
    return e.kind == "V" or e.kind == "E" or e.kind == "H"
end
local function independent(e)
    return e.kind == "V" or e.kind == "I"
end
local function element_terminals(e)
    if e.kind == "E" or e.kind == "G" then
        return {e.n1, e.n2, e.c1, e.c2}
    end
    return {e.n1, e.n2}
end
local function zero_vector(n)
    local result = {}
    for i = 1, n do
        result[i] = zero
    end
    return result
end
local function zero_matrix(n)
    local result = {}
    for i = 1, n do
        result[i] = zero_vector(n)
    end
    return result
end
local Union = {}
Union.__index = Union
function Union.new(nodes)
    local self = setmetatable({parent = {["0"] = "0"}}, Union)
    for _, node in ipairs(nodes) do
        self.parent[node] = node
    end
    return self
end
function Union:root(name)
    if self.parent[name] ~= name then
        self.parent[name] = self:root(self.parent[name])
    end
    return self.parent[name]
end
function Union:join(a, b)
    a, b = self:root(a), self:root(b)
    if a > b then
        a, b = b, a
    end
    self.parent[b] = a
end
local Circuit = {}
Circuit.__index = Circuit
function Circuit:nodes(include_ground)
    local set = {}
    for _, e in ipairs(self.elements) do
        for _, node in ipairs(element_terminals(e)) do
            if include_ground or node ~= "0" then
                set[node] = true
            end
        end
    end
    return keys(set)
end
function Circuit:node(name)
    if name == "0" then
        return
    end
    for _, node in ipairs(self:nodes(false)) do
        if node == name then
            return
        end
    end
    fail("unknown node %s", name)
end
function Circuit:index(name)
    for i, e in ipairs(self.elements) do
        if e.name == name then
            return i
        end
    end
    fail("unknown element %s", name)
end
function Circuit:add(fields)
    local name, kind, expected = fields[1], fields[1]:sub(1, 1), 4
    if kind == "E" or kind == "G" then
        expected = 6
    elseif kind == "F" or kind == "H" then
        expected = 5
    end
    if not ("RVIEGFH"):find(kind, 1, true) then
        fail("unknown element type %s", name)
    end
    if #fields ~= expected then
        fail("wrong field count for %s", name)
    end
    for _, e in ipairs(self.elements) do
        if e.name == name then
            fail("duplicate element %s", name)
        end
    end
    local count = (kind == "E" or kind == "G") and 4 or 2
    for i = 2, count + 1 do
        if not valid_node(fields[i]) then
            fail("invalid node %s", fields[i])
        end
    end
    local e = {name = name, kind = kind, n1 = fields[2], n2 = fields[3]}
    if kind == "E" or kind == "G" then
        e.c1, e.c2 = fields[4], fields[5]
    end
    if kind == "F" or kind == "H" then
        e.reference = fields[4]
        local found = false
        for _, source in ipairs(self.elements) do
            if source.name == e.reference and source.kind == "V" then
                found = true
            end
        end
        if not found then
            fail("unknown voltage source %s", e.reference)
        end
    end
    e.value = number(fields[#fields])
    if kind == "R" and e.value.n <= 0 then
        fail("nonpositive resistance %s", name)
    end
    self.elements[#self.elements + 1] = e
end
function Circuit:floating()
    local groups, result = Union.new(self:nodes(false)), {}
    for _, e in ipairs(self.elements) do
        if e.kind == "R" or voltage_source(e) then
            groups:join(e.n1, e.n2)
        end
    end
    for _, node in ipairs(self:nodes(false)) do
        if groups:root(node) ~= groups:root("0") then
            result[#result + 1] = node
        end
    end
    return result
end
function Circuit:source_loops()
    local groups, result = Union.new(self:nodes(false)), {}
    for _, e in ipairs(self.elements) do
        if voltage_source(e) then
            if groups:root(e.n1) == groups:root(e.n2) then
                result[#result + 1] = e.name
            end
            groups:join(e.n1, e.n2)
        end
    end
    return result
end
function Circuit:structure()
    if #self:nodes(false) == 0 then
        fail("no nodes")
    end
    local floating = self:floating()
    if #floating > 0 then
        fail("floating node %s", floating[1])
    end
    local loops = self:source_loops()
    if #loops > 0 then
        fail("voltage source loop at %s", loops[1])
    end
end
local Equations = {}
Equations.__index = Equations
function Equations:add(row, column, value)
    if row ~= "0" and column ~= "0" then
        local i, j = self.indices[row], self.indices[column]
        self.a[i][j] = self.a[i][j]:add(value)
    end
end
function Equations:rhs(vector, row, value)
    if row ~= "0" then
        local i = self.indices[row]
        vector[i] = vector[i]:add(value)
    end
end
function Circuit:build()
    local m =
        setmetatable(
        {nodes = self:nodes(false), names = {}, labels = {}, sources = {}, indices = {}},
        Equations
    )
    for _, node in ipairs(m.nodes) do
        m.names[#m.names + 1] = "V(" .. node .. ")"
        m.indices[node] = #m.names
        m.labels[#m.labels + 1] = node
    end
    for _, e in ipairs(self.elements) do
        if voltage_source(e) then
            m.names[#m.names + 1] = "I(" .. e.name .. ")"
            m.indices[e.name] = #m.names
            m.sources[#m.sources + 1] = e.name
            m.labels[#m.labels + 1] = e.name
        end
    end
    m.a, m.b = zero_matrix(#m.names), zero_vector(#m.names)
    for _, e in ipairs(self.elements) do
        local w = e.value
        if e.kind == "R" then
            local g = one:div(w)
            m:add(e.n1, e.n1, g)
            m:add(e.n2, e.n2, g)
            m:add(e.n1, e.n2, g:neg())
            m:add(e.n2, e.n1, g:neg())
        elseif e.kind == "I" then
            m:rhs(m.b, e.n1, w:neg())
            m:rhs(m.b, e.n2, w)
        elseif e.kind == "G" then
            m:add(e.n1, e.c1, w)
            m:add(e.n2, e.c2, w)
            m:add(e.n1, e.c2, w:neg())
            m:add(e.n2, e.c1, w:neg())
        elseif e.kind == "F" then
            m:add(e.n1, e.reference, w)
            m:add(e.n2, e.reference, w:neg())
        else
            m:add(e.n1, e.name, one)
            m:add(e.name, e.n1, one)
            m:add(e.n2, e.name, one:neg())
            m:add(e.name, e.n2, one:neg())
            if e.kind == "V" then
                m:rhs(m.b, e.name, w)
            elseif e.kind == "E" then
                m:add(e.name, e.c1, w:neg())
                m:add(e.name, e.c2, w)
            else
                m:add(e.name, e.reference, w:neg())
            end
        end
    end
    return m
end
local function solve(a, b)
    local n, rows = #b, {}
    for i = 1, n do
        rows[i] = {}
        for j = 1, n do
            rows[i][j] = a[i][j]
        end
        rows[i][n + 1] = b[i]
    end
    for k = 1, n do
        local pivot = k
        while pivot <= n and rows[pivot][k].n == 0 do
            pivot = pivot + 1
        end
        if pivot > n then
            return nil
        end
        rows[k], rows[pivot] = rows[pivot], rows[k]
        local divisor = rows[k][k]
        for j = 1, n + 1 do
            rows[k][j] = rows[k][j]:div(divisor)
        end
        for i = 1, n do
            if i ~= k then
                local factor = rows[i][k]
                if factor.n ~= 0 then
                    for j = 1, n + 1 do
                        rows[i][j] = rows[i][j]:sub(factor:mul(rows[k][j]))
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    local result = {}
    for i = 1, n do
        result[i] = rows[i][n + 1]
    end
    return result
end
function Equations:potential(solution, node)
    return node == "0" and zero or solution[self.indices[node]]
end
function Equations:voltage(solution, a, b)
    return self:potential(solution, a):sub(self:potential(solution, b))
end
function Equations:current(solution, e)
    if e.kind == "R" then
        return self:voltage(solution, e.n1, e.n2):div(e.value)
    elseif e.kind == "I" then
        return e.value
    elseif e.kind == "G" then
        return e.value:mul(self:voltage(solution, e.c1, e.c2))
    elseif e.kind == "F" then
        return e.value:mul(solution[self.indices[e.reference]])
    else
        return solution[self.indices[e.name]]
    end
end
function Equations:injection(a, b)
    local rhs = zero_vector(#self.b)
    self:rhs(rhs, a, one)
    self:rhs(rhs, b, one:neg())
    return solve(self.a, rhs)
end
function Equations:alone(e, value)
    local rhs = zero_vector(#self.b)
    if e.kind == "V" then
        self:rhs(rhs, e.name, value)
    else
        self:rhs(rhs, e.n1, value:neg())
        self:rhs(rhs, e.n2, value)
    end
    return solve(self.a, rhs)
end
local function reachable(start, edges)
    local seen, changed = {[start] = true}, true
    while changed do
        changed = false
        for _, e in ipairs(edges) do
            if seen[e.a] and not seen[e.b] then
                seen[e.b], changed = true, true
            end
            if seen[e.b] and not seen[e.a] then
                seen[e.a], changed = true, true
            end
        end
    end
    return seen
end
function Circuit:resistance(a, b)
    local groups = Union.new(self:nodes(false))
    for _, e in ipairs(self.elements) do
        if e.kind == "V" then
            groups:join(e.n1, e.n2)
        end
    end
    a, b = groups:root(a), groups:root(b)
    if a == b then
        return "Req = " .. zero:value()
    end
    local edges = {}
    for _, e in ipairs(self.elements) do
        if e.kind == "R" then
            local x, y = groups:root(e.n1), groups:root(e.n2)
            if x ~= y then
                edges[#edges + 1] = {a = x, b = y, value = e.value}
            end
        end
    end
    local component = reachable(a, edges)
    if not component[b] then
        return "Req = INFINITE"
    end
    local indices, names = {}, {}
    for _, node in ipairs(keys(component)) do
        if node ~= b then
            names[#names + 1] = node
            indices[node] = #names
        end
    end
    local matrix, rhs = zero_matrix(#names), zero_vector(#names)
    local function add(x, y, value)
        if x ~= b and y ~= b then
            local i, j = indices[x], indices[y]
            matrix[i][j] = matrix[i][j]:add(value)
        end
    end
    for _, e in ipairs(edges) do
        if component[e.a] then
            local g = one:div(e.value)
            add(e.a, e.a, g)
            add(e.b, e.b, g)
            add(e.a, e.b, g:neg())
            add(e.b, e.a, g:neg())
        end
    end
    rhs[indices[a]] = one
    return "Req = " .. solve(matrix, rhs)[indices[a]]:value()
end
function Circuit:reduce(a, b)
    if a == b then
        return {"Req = " .. zero:value()}
    end
    local list = {}
    for _, e in ipairs(self.elements) do
        if e.kind == "R" then
            list[#list + 1] = {name = e.name, a = e.n1, b = e.n2, value = e.value}
        end
    end
    local component = reachable(a, list)
    if not component[b] then
        return {"Req = INFINITE"}
    end
    local kept = {}
    for _, e in ipairs(list) do
        if component[e.a] then
            kept[#kept + 1] = e
        end
    end
    list = kept
    local lines, serial = {}, 0
    while true do
        local self_loop
        for i, e in ipairs(list) do
            if e.a == e.b then
                self_loop = i
                break
            end
        end
        if self_loop then
            lines[#lines + 1] = "remove " .. list[self_loop].name
            table.remove(list, self_loop)
        else
            local degrees = {}
            for _, e in ipairs(list) do
                degrees[e.a] = (degrees[e.a] or 0) + 1
                degrees[e.b] = (degrees[e.b] or 0) + 1
            end
            local internal = {}
            for _, node in ipairs(keys(degrees)) do
                if node ~= a and node ~= b then
                    internal[#internal + 1] = node
                end
            end
            local dangling
            for _, node in ipairs(internal) do
                if degrees[node] == 1 then
                    dangling = node
                    break
                end
            end
            if dangling then
                for i, e in ipairs(list) do
                    if e.a == dangling or e.b == dangling then
                        lines[#lines + 1] = "remove " .. e.name
                        table.remove(list, i)
                        break
                    end
                end
            else
                local first, second
                for i = 1, #list do
                    for j = i + 1, #list do
                        local x, y = list[i], list[j]
                        if x.a == y.a and x.b == y.b or x.a == y.b and x.b == y.a then
                            first, second = i, j
                            break
                        end
                    end
                    if first then
                        break
                    end
                end
                if first then
                    local x, y = list[first], list[second]
                    serial = serial + 1
                    local name = "#" .. serial
                    local value = x.value:mul(y.value):div(x.value:add(y.value))
                    lines[#lines + 1] =
                        string.format("%s = %s || %s = %s", name, x.name, y.name, value:value())
                    table.remove(list, second)
                    table.remove(list, first)
                    list[#list + 1] = {name = name, a = x.a, b = x.b, value = value}
                else
                    local middle
                    for _, node in ipairs(internal) do
                        if degrees[node] == 2 then
                            middle = node
                            break
                        end
                    end
                    if not middle then
                        break
                    end
                    local indices = {}
                    for i, e in ipairs(list) do
                        if e.a == middle or e.b == middle then
                            indices[#indices + 1] = i
                        end
                    end
                    first, second = indices[1], indices[2]
                    local x, y = list[first], list[second]
                    local u = x.a == middle and x.b or x.a
                    local v = y.a == middle and y.b or y.a
                    serial = serial + 1
                    local name = "#" .. serial
                    local value = x.value:add(y.value)
                    lines[#lines + 1] =
                        string.format("%s = %s + %s = %s", name, x.name, y.name, value:value())
                    table.remove(list, second)
                    table.remove(list, first)
                    list[#list + 1] = {name = name, a = u, b = v, value = value}
                end
            end
        end
    end
    lines[#lines + 1] =
        #list == 1 and "Req = " .. list[1].value:value() or
        string.format("not series-parallel: %d resistors remain", #list)
    return lines
end
local argument_counts = {
    [".OP"] = 0,
    [".CURRENT"] = 1,
    [".VOLTAGE"] = 2,
    [".POWER"] = 0,
    [".KCL"] = 1,
    [".THEVENIN"] = 2,
    [".NORTON"] = 2,
    [".MAXPOWER"] = 2,
    [".TF"] = 2,
    [".SENS"] = 1,
    [".ZPARAM"] = 4,
    [".SUPERPOSITION"] = 1,
    [".SWEEP"] = 5,
    [".MATRIX"] = 0,
    [".REQ"] = 2,
    [".REDUCE"] = 2,
    [".CHECK"] = 0,
    [".ALTER"] = 2,
    [".DELETE"] = 1,
    [".CLEAR"] = 0,
    [".NODES"] = 0,
    [".PRINT"] = 0
}
function Circuit:command(fields)
    local name = table.remove(fields, 1)
    local args, lines = fields, {}
    local function emit(format, ...)
        lines[#lines + 1] = string.format(format, ...)
    end
    if argument_counts[name] == nil then
        fail("unknown command %s", name)
    end
    if #args ~= argument_counts[name] then
        fail("wrong argument count for %s", name)
    end
    if name == ".ALTER" then
        local index = self:index(args[1])
        local value = number(args[2])
        local e = self.elements[index]
        if e.kind == "R" and value.n <= 0 then
            fail("nonpositive resistance %s", e.name)
        end
        emit("altered %s: %s -> %s", e.name, e.value:text(), value:text())
        e.value = value
        return lines
    elseif name == ".DELETE" then
        local index = self:index(args[1])
        for _, e in ipairs(self.elements) do
            if (e.kind == "F" or e.kind == "H") and e.reference == args[1] then
                fail("%s is referenced by %s", args[1], e.name)
            end
        end
        table.remove(self.elements, index)
        emit("deleted %s", args[1])
        return lines
    elseif name == ".CLEAR" then
        emit("cleared %d elements", #self.elements)
        self.elements = {}
        return lines
    elseif name == ".PRINT" then
        if #self.elements == 0 then
            emit("empty netlist")
        end
        for _, e in ipairs(self.elements) do
            local extra = ""
            if e.kind == "E" or e.kind == "G" then
                extra = e.c1 .. " " .. e.c2 .. " "
            elseif e.kind == "F" or e.kind == "H" then
                extra = e.reference .. " "
            end
            emit("%s %s %s %s%s", e.name, e.n1, e.n2, extra, e.value:text())
        end
        return lines
    elseif name == ".NODES" then
        local nodes = self:nodes(true)
        if #nodes == 0 then
            emit("no nodes")
        end
        for _, node in ipairs(nodes) do
            local names = {}
            for _, e in ipairs(self.elements) do
                for _, terminal in ipairs(element_terminals(e)) do
                    if terminal == node then
                        names[#names + 1] = e.name
                        break
                    end
                end
            end
            emit("%s: %s", node, table.concat(names, " "))
        end
        return lines
    elseif name == ".CHECK" then
        local nodes = self:nodes(false)
        if #nodes == 0 then
            return {"no nodes"}
        end
        local degrees = {}
        for _, e in ipairs(self.elements) do
            degrees[e.n1] = (degrees[e.n1] or 0) + 1
            degrees[e.n2] = (degrees[e.n2] or 0) + 1
        end
        for _, node in ipairs(nodes) do
            if (degrees[node] or 0) < 2 then
                emit("dangling node %s", node)
            end
        end
        for _, node in ipairs(self:floating()) do
            emit("floating node %s", node)
        end
        for _, source in ipairs(self:source_loops()) do
            emit("voltage source loop at %s", source)
        end
        if #lines == 0 then
            local m = self:build()
            emit(solve(m.a, m.b) and "ok" or "singular matrix")
        end
        return lines
    elseif name == ".REQ" or name == ".REDUCE" then
        self:node(args[1])
        self:node(args[2])
        return name == ".REQ" and {self:resistance(args[1], args[2])} or
            self:reduce(args[1], args[2])
    elseif name == ".SWEEP" then
        local index = self:index(args[1])
        local from = number(args[2])
        local to = number(args[3])
        local step = number(args[4])
        self:node(args[5])
        if step.n <= 0 then
            fail("invalid sweep step")
        end
        if from:compare(to) > 0 then
            fail("invalid sweep range")
        end
        local ratio = to:sub(from):div(step)
        local points = ratio.n // ratio.d + 1
        if points > 20 then
            fail("too many sweep points")
        end
        if self.elements[index].kind == "R" and from.n <= 0 then
            fail("nonpositive resistance %s", args[1])
        end
        self:structure()
        local temporary = setmetatable({elements = {}}, Circuit)
        for i, e in ipairs(self.elements) do
            local item = {}
            for key, value in pairs(e) do
                item[key] = value
            end
            temporary.elements[i] = item
        end
        for k = 0, points - 1 do
            local value = from:add(step:mul(fraction(k, 1)))
            temporary.elements[index].value = value
            local m = temporary:build()
            local solution = solve(m.a, m.b)
            if solution then
                emit(
                    "%s = %s: V(%s) = %s",
                    args[1],
                    value:text(),
                    args[5],
                    m:potential(solution, args[5]):value()
                )
            else
                emit("%s = %s: singular matrix", args[1], value:text())
            end
        end
        return lines
    end
    if name == ".CURRENT" then
        self:index(args[1])
    elseif name == ".TF" then
        self:node(args[1])
        local index = self:index(args[2])
        if not independent(self.elements[index]) then
            fail("not an independent source %s", args[2])
        end
    else
        for _, node in ipairs(args) do
            self:node(node)
        end
    end
    self:structure()
    local m = self:build()
    if name == ".MATRIX" then
        emit("unknowns: %s", table.concat(m.names, " "))
        for i, row in ipairs(m.a) do
            local values = {}
            for _, value in ipairs(row) do
                values[#values + 1] = value:text()
            end
            emit("%s: %s | %s", m.labels[i], table.concat(values, " "), m.b[i]:text())
        end
        return lines
    end
    local solution = solve(m.a, m.b)
    if not solution then
        fail("singular matrix")
    end
    if name == ".OP" then
        for _, node in ipairs(m.nodes) do
            emit("V(%s) = %s", node, m:potential(solution, node):value())
        end
        for _, source in ipairs(m.sources) do
            emit("I(%s) = %s", source, solution[m.indices[source]]:value())
        end
    elseif name == ".CURRENT" then
        local e = self.elements[self:index(args[1])]
        emit("I(%s) = %s", e.name, m:current(solution, e):value())
    elseif name == ".VOLTAGE" then
        emit("V(%s,%s) = %s", args[1], args[2], m:voltage(solution, args[1], args[2]):value())
    elseif name == ".POWER" then
        local absorbed, delivered, total = zero, zero, zero
        for _, e in ipairs(self.elements) do
            local power = m:voltage(solution, e.n1, e.n2):mul(m:current(solution, e))
            emit("P(%s) = %s", e.name, power:value())
            if power.n > 0 then
                absorbed = absorbed:add(power)
            elseif power.n < 0 then
                delivered = delivered:add(power:neg())
            end
            total = total:add(power)
        end
        emit("absorbed = %s", absorbed:value())
        emit("delivered = %s", delivered:value())
        emit("total = %s", total:value())
    elseif name == ".KCL" then
        local sum = zero
        for _, e in ipairs(self.elements) do
            if e.n1 == args[1] or e.n2 == args[1] then
                local current = zero
                if e.n1 ~= e.n2 then
                    current = m:current(solution, e)
                    if e.n2 == args[1] then
                        current = current:neg()
                    end
                end
                emit("I(%s) leaving %s = %s", e.name, args[1], current:value())
                sum = sum:add(current)
            end
        end
        emit("sum = %s", sum:value())
    elseif name == ".THEVENIN" or name == ".NORTON" or name == ".MAXPOWER" then
        local vth = m:voltage(solution, args[1], args[2])
        local rth = m:voltage(m:injection(args[1], args[2]), args[1], args[2])
        if name == ".NORTON" then
            if rth.n == 0 then
                fail("zero thevenin resistance")
            end
            emit("In = %s", vth:div(rth):value())
            emit("Rn = %s", rth:value())
        elseif name == ".MAXPOWER" then
            if rth.n <= 0 then
                fail("nonpositive thevenin resistance")
            end
            emit("RL = %s", rth:value())
            emit("Pmax = %s", vth:mul(vth):div(fraction(4, 1):mul(rth)):value())
        else
            emit("Vth = %s", vth:value())
            emit("Rth = %s", rth:value())
        end
    elseif name == ".TF" then
        local source = self.elements[self:index(args[2])]
        local unit = m:alone(source, one)
        emit("gain = %s", m:potential(unit, args[1]):value())
        if source.kind == "V" then
            local current = unit[m.indices[source.name]]
            if current.n == 0 then
                emit("input resistance = INFINITE")
            else
                emit("input resistance = %s", one:neg():div(current):value())
            end
        else
            emit("input resistance = %s", m:voltage(unit, source.n2, source.n1):value())
        end
        emit("output resistance = %s", m:potential(m:injection(args[1], "0"), args[1]):value())
    elseif name == ".SENS" then
        for _, e in ipairs(self.elements) do
            local rhs = zero_vector(#m.b)
            if e.kind == "R" then
                local value = m:current(solution, e):div(e.value)
                m:rhs(rhs, e.n1, value)
                m:rhs(rhs, e.n2, value:neg())
            elseif e.kind == "I" then
                m:rhs(rhs, e.n1, one:neg())
                m:rhs(rhs, e.n2, one)
            elseif e.kind == "G" or e.kind == "F" then
                local value =
                    e.kind == "G" and m:voltage(solution, e.c1, e.c2) or
                    solution[m.indices[e.reference]]
                m:rhs(rhs, e.n1, value:neg())
                m:rhs(rhs, e.n2, value)
            elseif e.kind == "V" then
                m:rhs(rhs, e.name, one)
            elseif e.kind == "E" then
                m:rhs(rhs, e.name, m:voltage(solution, e.c1, e.c2))
            else
                m:rhs(rhs, e.name, solution[m.indices[e.reference]])
            end
            emit("dV(%s)/d%s = %s", args[1], e.name, m:potential(solve(m.a, rhs), args[1]):value())
        end
    elseif name == ".ZPARAM" then
        local z1, z2 = m:injection(args[1], args[2]), m:injection(args[3], args[4])
        emit("z11 = %s", m:voltage(z1, args[1], args[2]):value())
        emit("z12 = %s", m:voltage(z2, args[1], args[2]):value())
        emit("z21 = %s", m:voltage(z1, args[3], args[4]):value())
        emit("z22 = %s", m:voltage(z2, args[3], args[4]):value())
    elseif name == ".SUPERPOSITION" then
        local total = zero
        for _, e in ipairs(self.elements) do
            if independent(e) then
                local value = m:potential(m:alone(e, e.value), args[1])
                emit("%s: V(%s) = %s", e.name, args[1], value:value())
                total = total:add(value)
            end
        end
        emit("total: V(%s) = %s", args[1], total:value())
    end
    return lines
end
local circuit = setmetatable({elements = {}}, Circuit)
local line_number = 0
for line in io.lines() do
    line_number = line_number + 1
    if line == ".END" then
        break
    end
    if line:sub(1, 1) ~= "*" then
        local ok, result =
            pcall(
            function()
                if line:sub(1, 1) == "." then
                    return circuit:command(words(line))
                else
                    circuit:add(words(line))
                    return {}
                end
            end
        )
        if ok then
            for _, text in ipairs(result) do
                io.write(text, "\n")
            end
        else
            if type(result) ~= "table" or not result.reason then
                error(result, 0)
            end
            io.write(string.format("error: line %d: %s\n", line_number, result.reason))
        end
    end
end
